questions.prompt: Which chart engine chunks should be in scope?
questions.description: The task file lists C2-C17. C1 (audit) is already done per the audit index.
questions.recommendedAnswer: C2 through C17, excluding C1 which is already complete.

questions.description: Chunks have dependencies (C2→C3→C5→C6→C7→C8). Some can parallelize (C3+C4, C9+C10, C11+C12).
questions.recommendedAnswer: Follow the dependency graph: sequential where required, parallel where safe.

questions.prompt: Should each chunk have tests before moving to the next?
questions.description: AGENTS.md requires table-driven tests for every service function.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Yes, each chunk must pass tests before the next chunk starts.

questions.prompt: Should each chunk be committed separately?
questions.description: AGENTS.md says every task must commit and push.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Yes, one commit per chunk with clear message.
